case_number: Civil Appeal @ SLP (C) No. 16442 of 2021 & Ors.
summary: The case involved service and pensionary benefits for a retired defense personnel. Key issues included the determination of pension eligibility, application of defense pension rules, and compliance with statutory and administrative procedures. The Court examined relevant regulations and precedents to assess whether the appellant's claims were maintainable and whether procedural fairness was observed. The reasoning emphasized consistency in administrative decisions and adherence to established pensionary norms.
legal_provisions_cited: The Pension Regulations for the Armed Forces
Article 14 of the Constitution of India
Union of India v. Ram Prakash & Ors.
final_judgment: The appeal was partly allowed, with directions issued to the authorities to reconsider the respondent’s pension claim in accordance with law and established precedents.
